lines: Ravikumar Krishnamurthi, Promoter Group, holds 15,000 shares before the offer and is not selling in it.
Their retained shares, valued at ₹2.03 crore (estimate, valued at offer price), unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 67 days ago.
Shares unlocked 67 days ago, so the holding is now liquid; the conversation can cover the 15,000 retained shares.
Caveat: the amount is an estimate valued at offer price, and the shares are not cash.
